result.rationale: The error concerns Claim 7's proof, which argues the reduction to G' preserves reconfigurability using only O(k)-sized sets; this argument (and its claimed linear-size conclusion) appears in LEMMA::6 and PROOF::4, but the proof text is truncated and the quantitative flaw (quadratic vs linear) isn't fully derivable from these snippets alone.

System flags local proof gaps (linear forest claim unsupported, J_m vs J_s mixup), not the annotated defect that the overall kernel bound is linear when it should only be quadratic (overstated bound later corrected).
